html:
The Kingdom of the Ouarsenis was a Berber kingdom in the Ouarsenis mountains of northwestern Algeria, south of the coast between Oran and Algiers. It is shown here in 700.

Little is known about it. Like the Kingdom of Altava to its west and the Kingdom of the Aurès to its east, it seems to have been one of the Romano-Berber states that grew up as Roman rule weakened and then as the Vandal kingdom lost control of the interior in the late 5th century. It probably mixed Berber chiefs with Roman-style towns and Christian worship. It was absorbed after the Arab conquest of the Umayyad era, during the 8th century.
